Key points
• Iodine is essential for the synthesis of thyroid hormone, which regulates growth, development, and metabolism.
• Multiple homeostatic mechanisms help to maintain stable thyroid hormone synthesis, but prolonged exposure to iodine
deﬁciency or excess can lead to thyroid dysfunction.
• Pregnant and lactating women and young children are the groups most vulnerable to the effects of iodine deﬁciency.
